title: Qwen3.6-27B Q5T16 pair- and octet-owned source-F16 producers

change.pair_mechanism: One local64 workgroup owns an adjacent Q5T16 column pair for one K256 block, reads each shared low-nibble and high-bit payload byte once, and emits both scalar-source-equivalent F16 columns.
change.octet_mechanism: One local256 workgroup owns the natural Q5T16 K256xN8 packed unit, reads four low-nibble bytes and one high-bit byte per K value, and emits all eight scalar-source-equivalent F16 columns.
change.fallback: registered scalar column-owned Q5T16 source-F16 producer

protocol.input: actual immutable Qwen3.6-27B blk.0.ssm_out.weight sole-Q5T16 payload
protocol.timing: 20 warmups, 31 alternating-order HIP-event samples, ten producer launches per timed burst
protocol.correctness: every candidate source-F16 byte compared with the current scalar producer at nonzero col_start=16
protocol.command_template: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<1 XTX|0 W7900> HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. /home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python /tmp/qwen36_q5_packed_producer_screen.py --tiles 1024,1280 --warmups 20 --samples 31 --burst 10 --output <output>

validation.red: pair/octet producer symbols, wrappers, composites, and registry keys were absent; five focused RED assertions failed
validation.green_w7900: focused Q5 packed-column byte and registry bundle: 3 passed
validation.correctness: both packed-column outputs are byte-identical to the existing scalar source-F16 producer on a nonzero tile offset and all actual-weight producer cells
validation.lineage: python3 scripts/check_lineage.py --kind kernel --diff stat; only the four known unrelated external parent drifts

decision: Retain both exact producer leaves and their diagnostic composites. Advance the faster octet owner to producer-inclusive production-chain screening; do not change runtime selection in this unit.
